source.description:
PROBLEM: Live operator-facing docs in /home/dawid/dev/core contradict shipped reality (memory retirement #639, Exa #636, serena strip #631, global hooks #630/#634, skills-v4 #621). A read-only audit produced 28 exact stale spots below — apply them.
SUCCESS: All spots below fixed on branch docs/sync-release-reality, pushed to origin, targeted doc/test suites green. No merge (coordinator merges after review).
SCOPE: These files only: docs/cli-architecture.md:37 (drop `/ memory` from tree); docs/policies.md:10 (`.xtrm/config/hooks.json`), :61 (delete using-xtrm row), :64 (drop `memory/`), :70 (delete service-skills row); docs/mcp.md (reconcile with mcp-servers.md v1.3.0: canonical sources, xt init sync, add exa row, reconcile optional table — or delete file in favor of mcp-servers.md if it adds nothing); docs/testing.md (replace retired skill IDs with nine v4 defaults per skills.md:47-59, quality-check hooks per hooks.md:70-78, engineering-quality for TDD, global ~/.claude/settings.json per #630); docs/cat-b-distribution.md:11-21 (two-row table per skills-ownership.md:27-30), :45 (flat .xtrm/skills/<pack>/); docs/skills-tier-architecture.md:56 (remove sync-docs line), :84-101 (flat layout), :252-259 (shipped pack exemplar); docs/project-skills.md:32-35 + :171 (flat layout paths); docs/todo.md:12,:15 (check off superseded); DELETE docs/skills-v4-causal-debugging-note.md after folding its content into engineering-quality/sre-ops references (v4 merged #621).
NON_GOALS: No merge. No README (separate lane xtrm-8e6cw). No CHANGELOG. No bannered historical trees (design/, plans/, proposals/ — already correct).
CONSTRAINTS: Branch docs/sync-release-reality ONLY from origin/main. Never push to main. Verify each fix against the cited live source (on-disk file or named doc section) before editing — if a cited source disagrees with the audit, flag and skip that spot. Keep edits minimal.
VALIDATION: Targeted suites green (doc-related tests); final grep for serena/bd-prime/memory-gate/tdd-guard/using-specialists-auto in edited files returns nothing.
OUTPUT: Pushed branch + per-spot report (fixed/skipped with reason).
SCRUTINY: MEDIUM
source.title: Docs sync to release reality
